findings.title: Supported-drop placement failure permanently consumes a named boss reward event
findings.evidence: defeatedSources.Add(enemy.GetInstanceID()) occurs before physical drop fitting. If TryResolveDrop returns false, OnDefeated logs and returns. No retry, reward escrow, rollback of consumed ID or alternate persistent reward exists in this path.
findings.reproduction: Isolated StageMapPreview only: defeat selected N2/N3/N4 at a location where real TryResolveDrop cannot find supported clear reachable floor (crowded stair/ledge or deliberately blocked test location); observe error and missing drop. Restore clearance or duplicate callback; no reward retry. Naturally occurring occurrence is not yet demonstrated.
findings.impact: The rules return a guaranteed matching fragment but a failed physical placement can prevent any fragment or full cargo reaching the world. This does not prove current authored home positions fail.
findings.recommendation: Validate current authored homes, patrol waypoints, stairs and cramped destinations with real drop+Interactor probes. If any failure occurs, retain pending rewards and retry safely or recover to a supported reachable location before consuming defeat identity; do not spawn embedded loot. No production fix made.

findings.impact: Unextracted new loot is not saved, but old equipment may be regained by restarting before death commit. Whether interruption rollback is intended is not established by the available current design; do not call it an approved insurance policy or a confirmed design violation.
